regions.text: I stand here today humbled by the task before us, grateful
regions.explanation: From 0.53s to 3.46s (“I stand here today humbled by the task before us, grateful”), articulation rate was 6.49 syll/s against 4.67 syll/s in the reference (+39%); that is 1.9× the reference speaker's natural word-to-word variation. Faster articulation compresses the stressed syllables and the micro-pauses listeners use to segment phrases, so key words lose emphasis and comprehension drops. Fix: Slow to the reference pace here and let the pauses between clauses breathe.
